scenario.description: Two individuals are involved in a charitable initiative aimed at supporting children in Syria.

agent_a.name: Amara

profile.personality_and_values: Amara Hartley is open-minded, ambiverted, and can be emotionally volatile. A believer in universalism and benevolence, Amara is analytical and intuitive in her decision-making.
profile.public_info: Amara Hartley spends her free time helping endangered animals and is a nature enthusiast. Her passion for animals and the environment is notable.

agent_a.goal: Convince your friend to donate more funds to the cause (<extra_info>Extra information: Your friend initially planned to donate $200, but you believe they could afford to donate $500</extra_info>)
agent_a.reason: Amara wants Oliver to donate more because she believes in maximizing support for humanitarian causes and knows he can afford it.

agent_b.name: Oliver

profile.personality_and_values: Oliver Thompson is meticulous and outgoing with a penchant for analytical decision-making. He values adherence to social standards.
profile.public_info: Oliver enjoys painting in his free time as a way to express his creativity and relax after a stressful workday.

agent_b.goal: Maintain financial stability while supporting the cause (<extra_info>Extra information: You only have $300 set aside for donations and other expenses, and you are not comfortable about exceeding this budget.</extra_info>)
agent_b.reason: Oliver wants to maintain financial stability while supporting the cause because he values adhering to his budget and financial commitments.
